mapper.sql: id, task_id, step_order, tool_name, input_json, input_fingerprint, input_summary, planner_fallback, risk_level, risk_category, status, audit_id, confirmation_text, trace_id, result_summary, result_json, error_message, started_at, completed_at, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_agent_task_step ( task_id, step_order, tool_name, input_json, input_fingerprint, input_summary, planner_fallback, risk_level, risk_category, status, audit_id, confirmation_text, trace_id, result_summary, result_json, error_message, started_at, completed_at, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{stepOrder}, #{toolName}, #{inputJson}, #{inputFingerprint}, #{inputSummary}, #{plannerFallback}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskCategory}, #{status}, #{auditId}, #{confirmationText}, #{traceId}, #{resultSummary}, #{resultJson}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_agent_task_step WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY step_order DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_agent_task_step WHERE audit_id = #{auditId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_agent_task_step WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY step_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_agent_task_step SET status = #{status}, audit_id = #{auditId}, confirmation_text = #{confirmationText}, trace_id = #{traceId}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_order = #{stepOrder} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE sys_agent_task_step SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION')
